nodes.name: Smartypants
nodes.what: The picture of a system while an agent is building it
nodes.why: A person can see the shape of the work and where the code left the request

nodes.name: Watch
nodes.what: Hears what the person asks and what the agent writes
nodes.why: The picture has to change with the work, and the agent keeps going if the picture fails

nodes.name: Picture
nodes.what: Holds the system, the parts of that system, and the slices inside each part
nodes.why: The watch and the board share one picture instead of guessing again each turn

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.what: Asks one model to write or update the picture
nodes.why: The switch names that model, and a wrong name must not call a different one

nodes.name: Memory
nodes.what: Remembers the first picture and what changed after it
nodes.why: A project that already has code needs a start, then only the changes

nodes.name: Board
nodes.what: Draws the picture on a desktop surface
nodes.why: This is how a person sees what the agent is building

nodes.name: Hosts
nodes.what: Claude, Codex, Grok, Muse, and Pi arrive as one kind of event
nodes.why: Five hosts should feed one picture

nodes.name: Switch
nodes.what: The project file that turns the watch on and names the builder
nodes.why: Nothing runs until that file is in the project root

nodes.name: Quiet turn
nodes.what: A turn that is already drawing the picture does not start another one
nodes.why: Muse and Pi would otherwise draw the picture again from inside the drawing

nodes.name: Depth
nodes.what: Shows the system, or its parts, or the slices inside those parts
nodes.why: The picture stops at the level the project asked for

nodes.name: Drift
nodes.what: Marks where the code left what was asked, once for each difference
nodes.why: A person needs that mark even when the code fits no part of the picture

nodes.name: Chosen model
nodes.what: Sends the depth, the ladder, and the short notes to that one model
nodes.why: The model has to use this project's depth, not files and functions as parts

nodes.name: Notes
nodes.what: Keeps the useful words from a turn
nodes.why: The memory is about the project, not the whole conversation

nodes.name: Older notes
nodes.what: Collapses earlier notes when the memory gets long
nodes.why: The next turn can still carry the history

nodes.name: Starting picture
nodes.what: Uses the file names already in the tree as the first picture
nodes.why: The start comes from the code that is there, before later turns track changes

nodes.name: Nesting
nodes.what: Puts each slice inside its part, and each part inside the system
nodes.why: The picture shows what contains what

nodes.name: The view
nodes.what: Drag and scroll when the picture is larger than the window
nodes.why: A system picture grows past one screen
